data_fields.name: npc_halving_divisor
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 x count (count starts at 1, +1 per applied CC)

data_fields.name: npc_hp_gate
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.75 (NPC health share below which CC is resisted)

data_fields.name: npc_window
data_fields.donor_constant: 60000 (fixed by NpcImmunityEffect constructor; configured timer not applied)

best_idea: Make crowd control self-limiting on a non-player target (each reapplication inside a window halves its duration and anything under one second is refused), and give players a fixed immunity window that starts when the control ends.
decision_why: The halving ladder, one-second floor, 75 percent NPC gate and window-after-end fit the one CC ladder for row 13 and Proof 3; key the ladder on target alone (the donor keys per CC kind) and let the NPC window follow the configured timer (the donor fixes it at 60 s).
acceptance: A server test lands an 8 s stun on an NPC, reapplies at 4 s, 2 s, 1.33 s and 1.0 s, refuses the next at 0.8 s, and refuses any stun or mez on a player for the window started when their 10 s stun ends (60 s with factor 6).
